title: Blush & Burgundy
description: Two polished cold-weather directions: one pairs a black Reformation boat-neck top with nude leggings, a camel peacoat, burgundy knit scarf, and cognac tall boots with a wine patent tote for a rich jewel-toned city look; the other builds a soft romantic outfit around a blush pink v-neck sweater, nude micro skirt, and a pale pink trench coat accessorized with the same dark brown heeled boots, a Kate Spade blush tote, and sheer nude tights — both looks illustrated by fashion sketches in the film strip reference frame.
occasion: city errands, lunch date, autumn/winter street style
